summary.oneLiner: Cosmic CRF Limited has demonstrated strong growth in Q4FY26, driven by capacity expansion, diversification into new segments, and strategic acquisitions, positioning itself for long-term growth and profitability.

one-line thesis: Cosmic CRF Limited has demonstrated strong growth in Q4FY26, driven by capacity expansion, diversification into new segments, and strategic acquisitions, positioning itself for long-term growth and profitability.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 412 crores (77% YoY growth); EBITDA: INR 64.4 crores (81% YoY growth); PAT (reported): INR 23.4 crores (128% YoY growth); PAT (normalized): INR 25.6 crores; Order Book: INR 760 crores; Net Debt: INR 120 crores
guidance: Revenue growth: 12-15% CAGR; Margin expansion: 100-150 bps; Order inflow: INR 1,000-1,200 crores; Capex: INR 50-75 crores
order book & pipeline: INR 760 crores, with a mix of railway and infrastructure orders
segment / subsidiary detail: Railway segment: 60% of revenue; Infrastructure segment: 30% of revenue; Defence segment: 10% of revenue
growth verticals / optionality: Diversification into defence equipment, expansion into new geographies, and increasing focus on exports
margins & cost dynamics: Raw material prices, labour costs, and freight costs are key margin drivers
capex / expansion: INR 50-75 crores, focused on capacity expansion and modernization
capital allocation: Debt reduction, capacity expansion, and strategic acquisitions
risks & watch-items: Regulatory risks, competition, and raw material price volatility
management quality / tone: Confident and optimistic, with a focus on long-term growth and profitability
non-obvious takeaways: The company's ability to navigate regulatory challenges and its focus on R&D and innovation

A data-center-cooling adjacency adds margin optionality.
